label: Caffeic acid attenuates stress-induced colon inflammation and barrier disruption in Sprague-Dawley rats.
summary: Chronic stress promotes colonic inflammation by sustaining activation of the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis, inducing oxidative stress, and disrupting barrier integrity, thereby exacerbating inflammatory bowel disease and irritable bowel syndrome. Therefore, there is a need for therapeutic compounds that can ameliorate stress-induced colonic inflammation.
